# 3Lift
> 3Lift is an advertising technology company focused on privacy-first, omnichannel advertising solutions for brands, agencies, and publishers.

3Lift provides programmatic advertising products spanning connected TV, video, display, native, and commerce media, with resources for buyers, sellers, and partners.

## Company
- [Home](https://3lift.com/): Overview of 3Lift’s advertising platform, solutions, and company positioning.
- [About](https://3lift.com/about/): Company background, mission, leadership, and business focus.
- [Careers](https://3lift.com/careers/): Open roles, hiring information, and company culture details.
- [Contact](https://3lift.com/contact/): Contact options for sales, partnerships, and general inquiries.

## Solutions
- [Solutions](https://3lift.com/solutions/): Summary of 3Lift products and omnichannel advertising capabilities.
- [Advertisers](https://3lift.com/advertisers/): Solutions and benefits for brands and agency media buyers.
- [Publishers](https://3lift.com/publishers/): Monetization and advertising technology offerings for publishers.
- [Commerce Media](https://3lift.com/commerce-media/): Retail and commerce media advertising capabilities and positioning.
- [CTV](https://3lift.com/ctv/): Connected TV advertising solutions and campaign capabilities.
- [Video](https://3lift.com/video/): Video advertising products and inventory activation details.
- [Display](https://3lift.com/display/): Display advertising formats, targeting, and performance positioning.
- [Native](https://3lift.com/native/): Native advertising solutions for scaled, privacy-conscious campaigns.
